games.label: Controlled jackpot slot
games.assumptions: Independent spins; gross multiplier table does not change with stake.

games.label: Controlled crash target
games.assumptions: The target multiplier is declared before the draw; P(reach target) = 0.97 / target multiplier.

games.label: Controlled lottery tail
games.assumptions: Each wager is one independent ticket; the sole prize is 100,000× gross at probability 8 per million.

games.label: Controlled virtual accumulator
games.assumptions: Independent synthetic events; the offered target has P(success) = 0.90 / target multiplier. No real matches are used.
